notes.subject: nonwane ya meala
notes.rationale: צבוע: 'speckled/dyed bird of prey' (KJV/JPS) vs 'the hyena' (from צבע stripped/dyed) — some read 'Is my heritage a hyena to me?'

notes.subject: צבוע
notes.rationale: Word appears only here in the Tanakh; its exact picture (speckled vs stripped) is unattested elsewhere

notes.subject: summons to the beasts
notes.rationale: Imperatives 'Tlogang… le kgobokantše… tleng' summon the beasts of the field to devour — a rhetorical summons

notes.subject: העיט…העיט
notes.rationale: The same word for 'bird of prey' frames the verse in repetition; the doubling is lost in paraphrase

translation: Na bofalwa bja ka ke nonwane ya meala go nna? Na nonwane ka moka di mo dikantše kgahlanong le yena? Tlogang, le kgobokantše diphoofolo tša lebala ka moka; tleng go e ja.
